description: A star under GROUP BY expands to its columns, each held to the grouped-select rule (live-verified): the fully-grouped shapes return COMPLETE rows - one value per expanded column, readable cell by cell - while a star covering an UNGROUPED column refuses with the standard sentence at the SENTINEL position, line 0 position -1, because nobody wrote the expanded reference. A qualified star names its qualifier in that sentence rather than the table. GROUP BY ALL with a star groups every column, so nothing can be ungrouped. Converted 1:1 from query/GroupedStarProjectionTest (now retired); the Java flattened every cell into one list, which the converted tests state as ordered row sets.

SELECT * FROM gstar_orders GROUP BY city, qty ORDER BY city, qty
CREATE TABLE gstar_orders (city VARCHAR, qty INTEGER)
